completed_unit.finding: Official Cargo documentation states that [patch] can override dependencies with other copies, can use path or git sources, applies transitively from the workspace root, and can replace an original crate version when a patched source provides that version. Combined only with this role's prior own-state finding that package.build=false disables automatic build-script detection for the alternate package itself, this supports the narrow mechanism hypothesis that a top-level consumer can substitute an alternate no-links dependency copy whose own manifest has build=false without editing the original upstream package.
completed_unit.verified_scope: Official Cargo Book 'Overriding Dependencies' [patch] section and examples; generic no-links dependency; consumer-controlled workspace-root Cargo.toml or documented patch configuration; no actual Cargo execution.
completed_unit.not_verified_scope: Whether any specific real dependency remains API/behavior compatible after removing its build script; whether generated code/native artifacts/environment setup are required; packages declaring links; source preparation mechanics; end-to-end build success; richer-mode parity; any external build execution.
residual_requirements: An alternate dependency source must exist with an appropriate package identity/version and a modified manifest containing build=false.
The consumer must point [patch] at that alternate path/git source and Cargo must resolve it.
